title: Cloud City: Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN, and Cloud Armor
city_concept: City Grand Arrival Gates, Customs Quarantine, and Express Parcel Depot

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Customers swarmed Brightloaf's tiny storefront entrance. Bad actors pushed in fake coupons, while shoppers in London had to send letters across the Atlantic for a menu.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Rae the Dispatcher constructed Global Edge Gates (Load Balancers & Anycast). Customs officers (Cloud Armor) filter bad actors, while regional kiosks (CDN) hand out menus instantly.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: A botnet flooded the gates with bogus catalog requests. Cloud Armor slammed the iron portcullis on the botnet while legitimate pastry shoppers walked in freely.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In physical gates, crowds cause street riots; Google Cloud Load Balancers handle millions of QPS without warm-up time.
